title: 评测集回放：准确率与格式合规率聚合
expected_output:
评测样本数 = 8
精确匹配准确率 = 0.5000 (4/8)
格式合规率 = 0.8750 (7/8)
结构化(JSON)期望样本数 = 2  JSON 可解析率 = 0.5000
准确率 < 格式合规率: True
两指标须在 Trace 中分开上报: True
code:
"""影子/回放评测: 对固定评测集聚合同类指标。"""
import json
import re

# (标准答案, 模型输出)
CASES = [
    ("42", "42"),
    ("北京", "北京"),
    ("-7", "答案是 -7。"),
    ("3.14", "3.140"),
    ("Paris", "paris"),
    ('{"ok": true}', '{"ok": true}'),
    ('{"n": 5}', "n = 5"),
    ("红色", "蓝色"),
]

def normalize(s):
    return s.strip().strip("。.!！").strip()

def gold_is_json(g):
    return g.strip().startswith(("{", "["))

def parse_ok(s):
    try:
        json.loads(s)
        return True
    except Exception:
        return False

exact = 0
compliant = 0
for gold, out in CASES:
    if normalize(gold).lower() == normalize(out).lower():
        exact += 1
    if gold_is_json(gold):
        # 期望结构化输出: 合规 = 输出本身可被 JSON 解析
        ok = parse_ok(out)
    else:
        # 期望短文本: 合规 = 不含额外解释性句子(长度接近标准答案)
        ok = len(normalize(out)) <= len(normalize(gold)) + 6
    compliant += ok

n = len(CASES)
json_cases = [c for c in CASES if gold_is_json(c[0])]
json_ok = sum(1 for g, o in json_cases if parse_ok(o))
print("评测样本数 = %d" % n)
print("精确匹配准确率 = %.4f (%d/%d)" % (exact / n, exact, n))
print("格式合规率 = %.4f (%d/%d)" % (compliant / n, compliant, n))
print("结构化(JSON)期望样本数 = %d  JSON 可解析率 = %.4f"
      % (len(json_cases), json_ok / len(json_cases)))
print("准确率 < 格式合规率:", (exact / n) < (compliant / n))
print("两指标须在 Trace 中分开上报: True")
